subject: Re: coref_mt5 status - positioning decision, batch-only for v1
body:
Decision, after talking to the document understanding folks and to Hana.

v1 is batch-only. We position entity threading as an overnight enrichment job, not an interactive feature, and we stop apologising for 190 seconds a document. That number is fine for a nightly pipeline and pretending otherwise is how we end up shipping chunking we don't trust.

Consequences:
- Chunking prototype stops. Yusuf, keep the write-up, kill the branch.
- Zeke, we still want the Shipyard slot but the SLA we're asking for is throughput, not latency - Daniela will send revised numbers.
- Launch review packet on Jul 20 goes in with 82.9 F1 English, two non-English languages, and an explicit batch-only scope line. Nadia, please don't let anyone re-litigate interactive in the room; it's decided.

Good work getting to parity, genuinely.

Priya
